author: Muse
description: Any discord.py bot, generic. Clone a Git repo or upload your own bot.py, set DISCORD_TOKEN, and run. Works on Pterodactyl / Pelican / FeatherPanel. Based on the Pterodactyl egg format used by eggs.mythicalsystems.org.
name: Discord.py

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Discord.py Generic Egg - Install Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# - GIT_REPO が設定されていれば、そのリポジトリを clone する
# - 未設定なら、ユーザーがファイルをアップロードする前提
# - PY_FILE が無ければ、動作確認用のサンプル bot.py を作る
# - requirements.txt があれば pip install -r する
# - discord.py[voice] は常にインストールする

cd /mnt/server

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y git curl gcc g++ libffi-dev libnacl-dev make

if [ -n "${GIT_REPO:-}" ]; then
  echo "Cloning ${GIT_REPO} (branch: ${GIT_BRANCH:-main})"
  if [ -n "$(ls -A /mnt/server 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "Server directory is not empty, skipping clone."
  else
    git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" --depth 1 "${GIT_REPO}" .
  fi
fi

if [ ! -f "${PY_FILE:-bot.py}" ]; then
  echo "No ${PY_FILE:-bot.py} found, creating a sample bot.py"
  cat > "${PY_FILE:-bot.py}" << 'PYEOF'
import os

import discord
from discord.ext import commands

TOKEN = os.environ.get("DISCORD_TOKEN", "")

intents = discord.Intents.default()
intents.message_content = True
bot = commands.Bot(command_prefix="!", intents=intents)


@bot.event
async def on_ready():
    print(f"Logged in as {bot.user} (ID: {bot.user.id})")
    try:
        synced = await bot.tree.sync()
        print(f"Synced {len(synced)} slash command(s)")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Slash command sync failed: {e}")


@bot.tree.command(name="ping", description="Botの応答速度を確認します")
async def ping(interaction: discord.Interaction):
    await interaction.response.send_message(f"Pong! {round(bot.latency * 1000)}ms")


@bot.command()
async def ping(ctx: commands.Context):
    await ctx.send(f"Pong! {round(bot.latency * 1000)}ms")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not TOKEN:
        raise SystemExit("DISCORD_TOKEN is not set. Set it in the Startup tab.")
    bot.run(TOKEN)
PYEOF
fi

if [ ! -f "${REQUIREMENTS_FILE:-requirements.txt}" ]; then
  echo "discord.py[voice]" > "${REQUIREMENTS_FILE:-requirements.txt}"
fi

echo "Installing python requirements"
python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
python3 -m pip install -U -r "${REQUIREMENTS_FILE:-requirements.txt}"

if [ -n "${EXTRA_PACKAGES:-}" ]; then
  echo "Installing extra packages: ${EXTRA_PACKAGES}"
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  python3 -m pip install -U ${EXTRA_PACKAGES}
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed."
echo "Set DISCORD_TOKEN in the Startup tab, then start the server."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
